interface.name: mm per Blender Unit
interface.description: 1000 if 1 BU = 1 m (Blender default). 1 if you model with 1 BU = 1 mm

interface.name: Line Width (mm)
interface.description: Extrusion width, used on top/bottom skins

interface.name: Groove Depth (mm)
interface.description: How deep the crease between layers is

interface.name: Edge Rounding
interface.description: Rounds the outer edge of each step on slopes

interface.name: Layer Inconsistency (mm)
interface.description: Random per-layer bulge (+ rare outlier layers)

interface.name: Micro Texture (mm)
interface.description: Fine extrusion ripple on each bead

interface.name: Layer Wobble (mm)
interface.description: Creases wander slightly instead of ruler-straight

interface.name: Bottom Line Depth (mm)
interface.description: First-layer lines on the bed side
